mcqs.keyword: Number and composition of gallantry awards
mcqs.question: In the 2026 gallantry awards for the armed forces, what was the total number and category-wise composition of the awards announced?
options: 70 awards: 1 Ashoka Chakra, 3 Kirti Chakras and 13 Shaurya Chakras
70 awards: 1 Ashoka Chakra, 13 Kirti Chakras and 3 Shaurya Chakras
17 awards: 1 Ashoka Chakra, 3 Kirti Chakras and 13 Shaurya Chakras
70 awards: 3 Ashoka Chakras, 1 Kirti Chakra and 13 Shaurya Chakras
mcqs.explanation: The 2026 gallantry awards comprised 70 awards: 1 Ashoka Chakra, 3 Kirti Chakras and 13 Shaurya Chakras. The most tempting alternative reverses the numbers of Kirti Chakras and Shaurya Chakras; the correct figures are 3 and 13, respectively.
